name: West Bay Club
insider_take: This intimate all-suite resort sits on Grace Bay Beach, consistently ranked among the world's best beaches for its pristine white sand and crystal-clear turquoise waters.
whats_special: West Bay Club is one of only a handful of boutique resorts directly on Grace Bay's coveted beachfront. The property features just 46 suites, ensuring an exclusive atmosphere, and sits adjacent to the protected Princess Alexandra National Park - meaning the pristine coastline will never be developed.
pro_tip: Book a beachfront suite on the upper floors for unobstructed views of the barrier reef, which creates the calm, swimmable waters that Grace Bay is famous for.
dont_miss: The world-class conch bar restaurant right on the beach serves the island's best conch fritters, and the nearby Conch Cove offers some of the Caribbean's most spectacular snorkeling just steps from your suite.
pros: Pristine beachfront location on Grace Bay Beach
Luxurious suites with full kitchens and private terraces
Exclusive boutique property with personalized service
cons: Remote island location requires advance planning
